sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM discontinued_date) AS disc_year, COUNT(DISTINCT generic_name_normalized) AS distinct_drugs, COUNT(*) AS episodes FROM health.fda_drug_shortages WHERE discontinued_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM discontinued_date) ORDER BY disc_year
SELECT DISTINCT snapshot_date FROM health.fda_drug_shortages_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2025-02-01' ORDER BY snapshot_date
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT generic_name) AS distinct_disc_2024 FROM health.fda_drug_shortages_history WHERE snapshot_date = '2025-01-17' AND discontinued_date LIKE '%/2024'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT generic_name) AS distinct_disc_2025 FROM health.fda_drug_shortages_history WHERE snapshot_date = '2026-01-20' AND discontinued_date LIKE '%/2025'
SELECT presentation FROM health.fda_drug_shortages_history WHERE snapshot_date = '2025-12-16' AND status = 'Current' LIMIT 20

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT generic_name, presentation
  FROM health.fda_drug_shortages_history
  WHERE snapshot_date = '2025-12-16' AND status = 'Current'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT generic_name) AS total_distinct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN presentation ILIKE '%Injection%' OR presentation ILIKE '%Injectable%' THEN generic_name END) AS injectable_distinct
FROM cur

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT generic_name, initial_posting_date
  FROM health.fda_drug_shortages_history
  WHERE snapshot_date = '2025-12-16' AND status = 'Current'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT generic_name) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN initial_posting_date LIKE '%2025' THEN generic_name END) AS first_reported_2025
FROM cur
